notes.content:
Howdy once again hunters! :small_bat:

We've just rolled out a patch for [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i], fixing a number of community-reported issues in the game!

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a warning when playing Escape as Bat/Escape as Mist while the Enraged Event Card is in play
[/list][h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Event Cards being discarded facedown when discarded due to exceeding the hand limit
[*] Fixed hunters being able to become delayed while defeated
[*] Fixed play button not reading "Resume" when loading an old save online
[*] Fixed an issue with sometimes not being able to quit out of the tutorials
[*] Fixed loading an offline save after connecting to online multiplayer replacing players with AI
[/list]
As always, if you If you see any issues in this latest patch, feel free to throw them our way via our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Nomad Games discord[/url]. We've got a super active Fury of Dracula community over there that will be very welcoming! :heart:

notes.title: The Revenant Update is live!
notes.content:
Hi hunters! :small_bat:

We've just rolled out [b]The Revenant Update[/b] for [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition![/i] Following on from The Immortal Update, the main feature of this update for the game is the ability to save and resume your online games!

This means that you can now start an online game with your friends, quit and save it, and then come back to it at a later time! We hope that this new feature will help people who've wanted to play [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] online but haven't had the chance due to time constraints or issues with scheduling.

This update also includes a number of changes, fixes and stability improvements to the game - we've put a lot of effort into making this a stable and solid release for the game, as our team are being shifted onto other projects for the foreseeable future. We wanted to make sure that if we didn't have a chance to come back to [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] soon, you were left with the best version of the game we could provide you all!

You can find the full patch notes for [b]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition v. 6.0.0. (aka The Revenant Update)[/b] below:

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added support for quitting and then resuming online games
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Hunter players can now back out of selecting a trade partner and choose to do a different action
[*]Dracula players can now back out of playing Wolf Form while choosing a location
[*]Dracula players can now back out of playing Misdirect while choosing a hideout on the trail
[*]Players can now choose to play as any number of hunters in single player rather than needing to be all four hunters
[*]Dracula's options when choosing to fight or avoid combat in a city with a Fog token now say "Avoid" and "Fight"
[*]Improved in-game performance
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed Great Strength being able to target hunters who were previously defeated
[*]Fixed Lucy's Revenge triggering when a hunter other than Lord Godalming is bitten/defeated after Lord Godalming was previously defeated
[*]Fixed Hunters being unable to play event cards that they previously passed on using after another hunter uses an event card during the same play opportunity
[*]Fixed assigning/unassigning a player to a character multiple times in an online game sometimes causing the character to be incorrectly controlled by AI
[*]Fixed Spy mature effect's hunter target not showing the cards and tickets in their hand
[/list]

notes.title: Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition - 5.2.0 patch
notes.content:
Howdy once again hunters! :small_bat:

Since we released the Immortal Update to you all, ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/958530/view/5991554339549914633]which you can find out all about here[/url]!) you've all given us great feedback, bug reports and general comments on the update. Based on that feedback and bug reports, we're rolling out the second post-Immortal Update patch today, which you can download now on Steam!

[h2]Added[/h2]

[*] Added map toggle button to trade dialog

[*] Fixed John Seward's cards overlapping the player hand area when his hand is full
[*] Fixed AI players using some event cards when they shouldn't be able to
[*] Fixed pre-combat prompts in online matches sometimes not appearing
[*] Fixed removing multiple Heavenly Host tokens sometimes causing a progression block
[*] Fixed an issue with the device localisation sometimes not being identified correctly which would prevent the game from starting
[*] Fixed selecting more cards than required causing a progression block
[*] Fixed not being able to quit the game whilst in the card selection of the combat dialog
[/list]

As always, if you If you see any issues in this latest patch, feel free to throw them our way via our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Nomad Games discord[/url]. We've got a super active Fury of Dracula community over there that will be very welcoming! :heart:

notes.content:

Last week we finally rolled out the Immortal Update ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/958530/view/5991554339549914633?l=english]check it out here[/url]), and we mentioned that we'd be rolling out further updates to fix issues that didn't quite make it into the update.

notes.title: The Immortal Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello hunters! :small_bat:

Today, we finally rolled out [b]The Immortal Update[/b] to all players on Steam! We wouldn't have been able to make this update possible without the support of the awesome [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] community. So from everyone here at Nomad Games, we want to say a massive thank you. :heart:

Many of the features, house rules and fixes included in this patch are based on feedback directly from you all, and part of the reason we could justify the development time for it is because of the demand and passion coming our way from the [i]Fury of Dracula[/i] community.

This update marks a major milestone for [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i], and we're going to be keeping a close eye on the patch now that it's out in the wild. We're fully expecting some more issues to arise or get noticed now that the patch is fully released, so expect some smaller patches in the near future as we address issues that get reported. If you see any, feel free to throw them our way via our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Nomad Games discord[/url]. 

Without further ado, let's get to the patch notes!

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added vampire encounter card health to the trail and on the cards themselves
[*] Added a Discord icon to the main menu that links to the Nomad Games Discord page
[*] Added a house rule for Dracula to choose a location or power card to place on the trail after sliding the trail
[*] Added a house rule where Dark Call draws the top card on the event deck
[*] Added a house rule to control how much influence Dracula gains when maturing a vampire hideout with a rumour token
[*] Added button in combat UI and card selection to allow players to view the map
[*] Added more context information when placing an encounter card on a hideout
[*] Added a prompt to inform players that Dracula is choosing whether or not to cancel a combat using a Fog token
[*] Added text indicating how many cards need to be selected in multiple situations (E.G. discarding after using the Supply action)
[*] Added visibility token to lair dialog so Dracula knows which lairs have been discovered by hunters
[*] Added visibility token to event and item cards during trading so weakened hunters can see which of their cards are revealed
[*] Added revealed text to event and item cards during discarding
[*] Added toggle in the settings menu to reduce figurine size to improve visibility of the map around them 
[*] Added Dracula/vampire location name to combat info dialog
[*] Added move confirmation dialog for Dracula when moving to a lair
[*] Added additional prompt when using escape as bat to allow Dracula to remove lairs before moving away
[*] Added house rule to make Dracula markers invisible to Dracula
[*] Added toggle in the settings menu to increase animation speeds
[*] Added toggle in the settings menu to automatically close the following in-game dialogs:
[list][*]Ok dialogs
    [*]Card invoked dialogs
    [*]Untimed card reveal dialogs (E.G. Spy and Consecrated Ground)[/list][*] Added toggle in the settings menu to make roads and railways brighter
[*] Added a house rule to forbid Dracula from using Wolf Form when in a city with a Consecrated Ground or Heavenly Host token
[*] Added a house rule to remove Rumour Tokens from hideouts on the trail with no encounters
[*] Added patch notes dialog to main menu and settings
[*] Added context to certain "Waiting for..." prompts to better explain what is being awaited
[*] Added pop-up notification to inform players when Dracula clears a lair
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed Hunter Combat Hand Size info to just display how many item cards the hunter has
[*] Dracula can now view discarded facedown encounter cards
[*] Dracula now heals before the match ends when normally moving to Castle Dracula
[*] Viewing cards revealed by Spy and Consecrated Ground is no longer on a timer
[*] All players in online combat now choose their combat cards at the same time rather than one after another
[*] Dracula markers can now be removed by placing a marker on a location which already has a marker
[*] Selecting coastal cities during Excellent Weather improved
[*] Mature or lair prompt added to replace the confusing yes or no prompt
[*] Chat button is now available while the player is in most dialogs/prompts
[*] Text in chatbox doesn't get all selected upon reopening the chat
[*] When selecting event or discarding cards the multiple select dialog will appear no matter how many cards are available for consistency sake
[*] Adjusted zoomed out camera position for better visibility of Cadiz
[*] Discard menus selected list is now properly localised
[*] The play card button in combat now says "Take Card" during Plotting
[*] A single hunter can no longer play multiple Planned Ambushes at once
[*] Hunters can discard rail tickets after collecting new tickets
[*] Button text when making card choices now updates to better reflect what the player will do rather than always saying "Submit"
[*] Wolf Form now allows Dracula to select his current city if he is able to play hide rather than a separate prompt to play Hide
[*] Dracula is now able to choose any number of encounter cards in a maturing hideout to mature while the rest are discarded
[*] Mina Harker's Psychic Bond result stands out more when Dracula is in the same region as Mina Harker
[*] A hunter affected by bats on Cagliari now simply becomes delayed when they would take their next action rather than being affected by bats until they are able to move by road
[*] Updated night supply prompt to be more clear on the risk for hunters
[*] Hunter players who control multiple hunters now only have one mute button next to their first character
[*] Reduced likelihood that AI Dracula moves to a location in which he cannot legally move out of
[*] Encounter card source hideout is now displayed if Hide is involved when choosing the order to ambush/search
[*] Spectators being present in the lobby before starting a match no longer prevents the match from starting
[*] Can now select the same card as before when using planned ambush
[*] Viewing information no longer gets interrupted when another player performs an action which uses the same dialog (E.G. viewing a discard pile when another player supplies)
[*] "Waiting for..." prompts no longer appear in the following situations:[list]
[*] Choosing an event card gained from Immanuel Hildesheim's ally effect to play immediately 
[*] Choosing an event card to play at the end of the Dracula phase
[*] Choosing an item card to play before searching a hideout
[/list][*] Obscured "Waiting for..." prompt in the following situations:[list]
[*] Choosing a card to play before being ambushed
[*] Choosing a card to play before combat starts
[*] Choosing an event card to play at Dawn or Dusk
[/list][*] Updated psychic bond dialog options to be more clear to the player
[*] Updated hired scouts so you can select from all cities in one go rather than region selection first
[*] Updated various dialogs to include player name in the title
[*] Default auto consume rail tickets to off
[*] Tweaked selection area of road and rail between Nuremberg and Munich to improve selection of Munich
[*] Dracula marker location selection doesn't require selecting a region first
[*] Hunters can now play Garlic Wreath before playing Lucky Find
[*] "Waiting for..." prompts no longer block players from viewing information
[*] Hunters now only have 1 Dracula marker when controlling multiple hunters
[*] Dracula marker button is now available in more situations
[*] Discarded Item cards are now shown faceup to other players during the discard animation
[*] Removed film grain effect on the main menu (this only applies to the iOS version!)
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed using sea locations when calculating the distance between the location a hunter was defeated at and the nearest hospital
[*] Fixed Dracula drawing initial encounter cards after initial placement rather than before
[*] Fixed hunters not discarding rail tickets when moving to a hospital
[*] Fixed Dracula not being able to play the Feed power card while at full health
[*] Fixed Dracula being revealed when on a City where the only present hunters are in a hospital
[*] Fixed Wolves mature effect not being able to target hunters in the same city as Wolves
[*] Fixed Spy affecting multiple hunters
[*] Fixed Szgany Bodyguards affecting multiple hunters
[*] Fixed a freeze that occurred when selecting a card too quickly when in combat
[*] Fixed double chat icon appearing in online combat while in the 'waiting for...' prompt
[*] Fixed hunters remaining delayed and/or impaired by bats when being defeated
[*] Fixed delayed hunters being able to join another hunter's combat with a New Vampire
[*] Fixed Behind the Veil not revealing the discarded encounter card
[*] Fixed Szgany Bodyguards mature effect resolving before hunters can use event cards to cancel the combat
[*] Fixed not resolving all Szgany Bodyguard mature effects when there are multiple Szgany Bodyguards in play
[*] Fixed not updating the interactive guide when using the in-game settings toggle
[*] Fixed Dark Call, Feed, Wolf Form and Misdirect not being readable on the trail to hunters
[*] Fixed online "replace with AI" dialog remaining open after the player rejoins
[*] Fixed Chartered Carriage using a special action rather than a movement action
[*] Fixed Wax Cylinders text not mentioning that it is used as an action
[*] Fixed Fast Horses not triggering Wild Horses
[*] Fixed Rumor Tokens being lost upon converting a hideout into a lair
[*] Fixed Dracula being unable to move using Escape as Bat when all adjacent cities are on the trail
[*] Fixed Dracula being unable to move using Wolf Form at sea when all adjacent ports are on the trail
[*] Fixed Forewarned triggering when a another hunter in the same city is ambushed by an encounter which affects multiple hunters
[*] Fixed character seals on the left of the main screen not updating which character is highlighted if the player is viewing a non-highlighted character
[*] Fixed character portrait in the bottom left of the main screen sometimes getting stuck during its rotation animation in online games
[*] Fixed advanced rules display in the pause menu not correctly showing when free placement is enabled
[*] Fixed using False Tip during the first action of Renewed Vigor skipping the hunter's second action
[*] Fixed cards in discard piles sometimes appearing too large
[*] Fixed cards on the trail sometimes remaining visually after they have been removed
[*] Fixed some cases where hunter action buttons appeared for Dracula/Spectators
[*] Fixed faceup event cards from the event deck obtained by Dracula through Hoax's mature effect remaining faceup in Dracula's hand
[*] Fixed incorrect opacity for the road between Rome and Naples
[*] Fixed hunters being able to become delayed to discard Aristocratic Vampire when they are already delayed
[*] Fixed defeated hunters being able to reveal Heavenly Host during Consecrated Ground
[*] Fixed Sense of Emergency not triggering Wild Horses
[*] Fixed ambient audio for being in a port city when Dracula is not revealed
[*] Fixed defeated hunters being able to play event cards at dawn or dusk
[*] Fixed Dracula not being correctly revealed when using Wolf Form to move to a revealed Lair
[*] Fixed Escape Route choices including hunters which declined to be in the combat with New Vampire
[*] Fixed progression block when a hunter becomes impaired by bats at night and Renewed Vigor is played the next dawn
[*] Fixed Fangs heal not updating the vampire's health text at the correct time
[*] Fixed Dogs triggering when another hunter in the same city is ambushed by Rats, Saboteur, Spy or Wolves
[*] Fixed influence tracker not moving in front of the combat UI when the influence increases during combat
[*] Fixed Dracula markers being reset when rejoining a online game or loading a local game
[*] Fixed combat info dialog sometimes not showing all cards affecting characters in combats after the card was used in a previous combat
[*] Fixed Dracula marker button being usable during transitions and actions as it would cause action buttons to disappear and place other hunters markers
[*] Fixed hunters gaining 2 health when resting on a city in which John Seward was just defeated
[*] Fixed hunters being able to perform their second action during Renewed Vigor if they were defeated during their first action from an ambush
[*] Fixed memory leak when rejoining games
[*] Fixed Bats token not triggering on a hunter's action if the Bats token was applied during the hunter's first action of Renewed Vigor
[*] Fixed hunters drawing an event card when being forcibly moved by Dracula during the night phase when Long Night is in play
[*] Fixed cards in carousels occasionally exiting their dialog and getting stuck
[*] Fixed hunter players in online matches being unable to see when a non-engaged hunter is damaged with the second claws attack
[*] Fixed progression block when a Reckless Vampire uses Fangs on a Mesmerized hunter during an ambush at Night
[*] Fixed hunter players being unable to see Dracula stats at the end of a match and vice versa
[/list]

Congratulations on getting through that massive list of changes and updates!

Now you've done that, don't forget to join our awesome [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] community, which you can find on our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Nomad Games discord[/url]. Oh, and follow us on [url=https://linktr.ee/nomadgames]all our social channels[/url] for more Fury updates, and the latest from our small studio!

Hi hunters! ːsmall_batː

It's been quite a while since we've chatted, and we're very pleased to announce we're rolling out an update for [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i]! We've just rolled out a new public beta for [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i], giving you access to the 'Immortal' 5.0 patch for the game.

To join the beta, select [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] in your Steam library, choosing 'Properties' and then navigating to the beta menu! From there, you can opt-in to the open beta.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38289266/b9cf198926372a24d7f9039d24dba3930aeca11a.png[/img]

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE[/b][list]
[*] Any local saves from the non-beta version won't support these new features/changes
[*] You'll only be able to play online against other players who are also on the Immortal Update beta
[/list]
Because there are so many changes, updates and fixes in The Immortal Update, we're rolling this update out first as a beta. We're fully expecting there to be some bugs and issues that we haven't picked up on during our internal testing (due to the sheer number of changes we've included) so if you notice any bugs or issues in the beta version, please post them either on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/958530/discussions/1/]Steam forums[/url], or in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/260947555901374475/776040795769405441]#bug-reporting channel[/url] on our official Discord!

[*]Added a house rule to control how much influence Dracula gains when maturing a vampire hideout with a rumour token
[*]Added button in combat UI to allow players that are in combat to view the map

notes.content:
Hello there hunters! ːsmall_batː

We've hope you've all been sharpening your stakes - we've got the latest update for [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] live now on Steam! This is the update we mentioned in our last blog about what you can expect for Fury in the future. You can read the full thing [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/958530/announcements/detail/4509778749596144600]here on Steam[/url] if you missed it!

Below you can find the full changelog for this update.

[h1]Added[/h1]
[list]
[*] Online games can now be spectated
[*] Online games can be rejoined (a much requested feature!)
[*] Added an "Auto-Consume Rail Ticket" option to the settings menu, which can be toggled off to allow the hunter to choose which rail ticket they discard when moving by rail
[*] Added feedback when the hunter you are trading with accepts your proposal
[/list]
[h1]Changed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Dracula is now warned when promoting a hideout to a lair that revisiting a revealed lair will reveal Dracula's current location
[*] Multiple cards being received, revealed or discarded are now displayed all at once in most instances
[*] The timer can now be skipped or halted on the dialog which shows cards being received, revealed or discarded
[*] Replaced most information buttons in combat with a single combat information button, which displays a dialog with all the combat information
[*] Hunters in hospital now appear closer to the hospital section of the city
[*] Altered how AI Dracula selects connections for token placement
[*] The camera will now focus on tokens being placed or removed from the map by remote or AI players
[/list]
[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*] AI hunters will now always accept trade proposals
[*] AI Van Helsing will now offer to trade with other hunters who have event cards that they cannot play
[*] AI hunters will now trade synergistic item cards if available (e.g. if you have Pistol and they have Holy Bullets)
[*] Fixed Dracula not drawing a card after a hunter encounters Bats at night when Long Night is in play
[*] Fix playing Good Luck to cancel False Tip while under Speedy Telegraph online causing a block
[*] Fixed not being able to view a non-Dracula vampire's combat status effect cards after it gains a status effect
[*] Fixed text clashing with Dracula's combat card icon in combat after choosing to replace the hunter's combat card
[*] Fixed characters on a hospital city not rearranging or resizing when a hunter enters that hospital
[*] Fixed John Seward's combat taunt audio not playing correctly
[*] AI Dracula can no longer use Vampiric Influence to move a hunter by road to a city that is only adjacent by rail
[*] Customs Search no longer has its effect applied twice when used in conjunction with False Tip
[*] Connections to cities that cannot be moved to are no longer highlighted when they shouldn't be
[*] AI Dracula will no longer use Rumour Tokens illegally
[/list]

You should be able to download the update now on Steam! Once you do, make sure you remember to join the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Nomad Games discord[/url] to chat and play with other Fury of Dracula players.

notes.title: Fury of Dracula Updates!
notes.content:
Hi Hunters! ːsmall_batː

Long time no speak! We’ve been crazy busy here at Nomad, which means we’ve been silently lurking in the shadows waiting for the right time to pounce on some unsuspecting [strike]victims[/strike] [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] players. It’s been a while since we chatted about anything, so we’ve got a ton to get you up to speed on!

[h2]Where Have We Been?[/h2]

So the question that we imagine a lot of you are asking is [i]“Where have you been?”[/i] or [i]“What have you been working on?”[/i]

Well, sadly we haven’t been scouring across Europe in an epic real life recreation of [i]Fury of Dracula[/i] - even though that would be mighty cool. Nope, instead we’ve been busy working on both our next project as a studio (another digital board game adaptation that we can’t talk about just yet) and also we’ve been doing some contract work to help out our pals at [url=https://www.electricsquare.com/]Electric Square[/url] on their latest game - [url=https://www.electricsquare.com/detonation-racing/]Detonation Racing[/url]!

We’ve got a small team here at Nomad, so our usual cycle for game development and creation means that we use some of our team to work on the next game while the rest of our team stick around to work on/polish up the game we just released. For a number of different reasons (timings lining up right and our workloads) we had the opportunity to help some other games studios with projects they were working on.

We’ve now finished that work for other studios, which means while we’re still working on our next secret board game project, we can take some time to come back to [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i].

[h2]Upcoming Updates for Fury[/h2]

We’re hoping to release the next update mighty soon, and right now we’ve got these features planned for future updates:
[list]
[*] The ability to spectate online games
[*] The ability to rejoin online games
[*] Adding an "Auto-Consume Rail Ticket" option to the settings menu, which can be toggled off to allow the hunter to choose which rail ticket they discard when moving by rail
[*] A number of improvements to how AI hunters handle trading
[*] A wide range of fixes to bugs 
[/list]
We’re not sure if all of these will be in the next update, as we’re still testing and figuring out what we can safely include without breaking anything - so lots of testing is going to be happening with our internal QA team!

[h2]German Language[/h2]

Back when we first launched Fury of Dracula, we took a look at what languages we wanted to bring the game to once it’d been released. It’s taken longer than expected, but we’re excited to bring the first non-English language to Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition when we roll out the German language option!

To celebrate, we bought some German snacks - because the best way to understand a country is by eating snacks, right? If any German fans can tell us how well we've done, we'd appreciate it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38289266/f608b8011c65bd08f9763aa8472ef9bd961cea72.jpg[/img]

Right now, we’ve got a huge spreadsheet that contains all the translated text for [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] in German, we just need to actually put it inside the game. 

We’re hoping that these snacks will give us the energy we need for all that copy-and-pasting!

[h2]Open Beta Testing[/h2]

As part of these upcoming updates, we’re also going to be opening up the beta version of [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] to a wider audience. Previously you needed to be part of the closed beta in order to play newer versions of the game, but we’re welcoming feedback from anyone willing to get involved. We’ve created a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/958530/discussions/0/4758602630159725516/]discussion[/url] on the Steam forums if you’d like to give us feedback, or you can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Discord[/url] and chat directly with us!

If you’d like to try out the beta version, you just need to do the following:
[list]
[*] Right click Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition in your Steam games library
[*] Go to Properties
[*] Click Betas
[*] Click The Dropdown
[*] Select open-beta - Public Beta
[/list]
[h2]Monthly Nomad Games Mailbag[/h2]

Last month, we launched the Nomad Games Monthly Mailbag - every month we’re opening ourselves up to questions from the community on anything and everything!

You can check out the August Edition of the Mailbag [url=https://nomadgames.co.uk/blog/august-2021-mailbag]here[/url]. And if you’d like to have your questions answered, you can send them over to questions@nomadgames.co.uk - we’ll even give out some Steam keys for the best questions!

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]

So what exactly have we got planned next for [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] beyond these updates and adding German? Well, we’re hoping that we’ll be able to bring the game to even more platforms now that it’s out on both PC and mobile. We’re also planning on adding more house rules to the game, so you can play [i]Fury of Dracula[/i] in new ways!

As soon as we’ve got more to share on that front, we’ll be sending telegrams to each and every hunter out there. Until then, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Nomadgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/NomadGamesLTD/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/nomad_games/]Instagram[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Discord[/url] to find out more about the latest things we’re working on. Oh, and happy hunting!

notes.title: 1v4 Online Multiplayer Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello hunters!

Before we all went home for Christmas, we invited you to take part in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/958530/view/2914356290483023541]1v4 online multiplayer beta[/url]. After the success of the beta, we’ve decided to roll out the full 1v4 experience to everyone! So as of the latest update on Steam, you can play [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] online with up to 5 players.

We also support any configuration for online multiplayer as long as you’ve got at least 2 players, so 4 human hunters can try to take down 1 AI Dracula if none of you feel like playing as the Count!

You can find the full changelog for this update here:

[h1]Added[/h1]
[list]
[*] 4v1 online multiplayer is now out of beta
[*] Online games now have text chat. The chat filter can be enabled/disabled locally in the settings
[*] Added feedback to Spy when the target hunter has no item or event cards
[/list]
[h1]Changed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated feedback for when a hunter uses Hired Scouts or a hunter ally to search to include what cities were searched
[*] AI Hunters will now apply more weight to travelling via land rather than sea when determining how to get to a target location
[*] AI Hunters will now be more inclined to remain in combat
The pause menu button can now be selected during tutorials
[/list]
[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed unlocalised text in the Renewed Vigor Delayed dialog
[*] Fixed Hired Scouts and the hunter ally cards requiring the hunter to select a location to reveal when the only unrevealed trail locations are in the sea
[*] Fixed an issue where the AI Hunters would sometimes move away from Dracula's location during the day phase
[*] Fixed an issue with the AI Hunters not targeting Dracula's location when he is revealed if he moved onto the same location as another Hunter
[*] Fixed resuming a game while Speedy Telegraph is in play temporarily locking the character seal buttons
[*] Fixed combat being initiated with a hunter defeated by Szgany Bodyguard's mature effect
[*] Fixed combat prompt text not appearing for all players
[*] Fixed Dracula's Brides' ally effect not returning Dracula's action buttons
[*] Fixed being unable to resume if a game is quit after Dracula has started placing Storm or Roadblock tokens, but before all have been placed
[*] Fixed AI Hunters failing to choose a card during combat with a vampire in a Hideout which also contains an Encounter card with no mature effect
[*] Fixed discard pile counters not showing the right value initially after loading a save file
[/list]

[h3]What about chatting to each other during a game?[/h3]

So as part of the 1v4 update, we’ve also added a dedicated in-game text chat feature for when you’re playing online!

With this new feature, you can coordinate with people online or taunt your foes as Dracula. This feature is available no matter how many people you’re playing online with, so next time you’re having a 1v1 showdown, feel free to let Dracula know just how much you’re onto his trail.

This text chat function will also be massively helpful when we release the mobile version of the game with cross-play, as we need to make sure people on different platforms can communicate with each other easily. If you want more updates on the mobile version of [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i], the best way to do that is by following us on social media!

[h3]How can I stay updated on the game?[/h3]

You can follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/NomadGamesLTD/]Facebook[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/Nomadgames]Twitter[/url] for the latest updates, or join our lovely [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Discord[/url] to chat with other players and our development team! We’re also always open to feedback and ideas, so send them all our way!

And finally, we know this is a feature a lot of people have been asking for since the game launched, so we can’t wait to see what you all think of it! We’ve been working super hard to get it to you, and we appreciate all your patience. ːheartː

notes.title: Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition - 1v4 Public Beta
notes.content:
Hello hunters! 

We’re happy to inform you that we’re now opening up the beta version of 1v4 online multiplayer in [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] to anyone who has purchased the game and wants to help us!

We’ve been working hard on the 1v4 online multiplayer feature since we released the game on Steam, and we’ve made some amazing progress so far. However, as Christmas fast approaches we’re going to have less and less staff on hand to test new builds and roll out fixes for issues, which is why we’ve made the decision to open up a public beta over the holidays. This will give you all a chance to get your hands on the 1v4 multiplayer feature early, and also provide us with some valuable feedback for when we return in the new year.

We’re hoping that with all of you playing over the holidays, we’ll be able to come back in January to a comprehensive list of things that need fixing ahead of the final release for 1v4 online. We’ve set up a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/958530/discussions/0/2986413884531742086/]discussion on Steam[/url] where you can report your beta bugs, and we’ve also set up a new channel on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]official Discord[/url] just for talking about the public beta.

If you don’t mind coming across issues and reporting them to us, you can jump on 1v4 now!

So, how do you get involved?

[b]TO PLAY 1v4 ONLINE NOW:[/b]
[list]
[*] Right click Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition in Steam
[*] Go to Properties
[*] Click Betas
[*] Enter this code: furyofdracula
[*] Select ‘open-beta’
[/list]
It’s worth noting that if you’re on the beta version of [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] then you’ll only be able to play online with people who are also using the beta version. If you want to play with friends who aren’t using the beta version, make sure you revert back to the original version by going into Properties, then Betas again and selecting NONE!

Also, trying to fix 4v1 multiplayer issues can be complicated and time consuming so if you do run into any major issues (such as the game getting out of synchronisation, stuck on a dialog or not being able to perform actions) then please ensure that you provide as much information as possible about the problem when reporting it to us, including the player logs from all players involved renamed to clearly highlight for which characters they are for. You can find the player log files here - C:\\Users\\(your username)\\ AppData \\ LocalLow \\ Nomad Games \\ Fury of Dracula

Although this involves a little effort on your part, it will help us enormously with cross referencing the events that led up to the issue. You can send us player logs via support@nomadgames.co.uk or through our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Discord[/url]! Just be sure to tell us that you’re on the beta version, so we can properly categorise issues.

And finally, from everyone here at Nomad Games, many thanks for your patience and support over the last year - we hope you all have a lovely time this holiday season!

notes.title: An Update on 1v4 Online!
notes.content:
Hello hunters!

As promised, I’ve got an update for you all regarding the ongoing work we’re doing to bring 1v4 multiplayer to you all in [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i]. We know you’re all keen to get your hands on the update, which is why we want to keep you in the loop on how it’s coming along!

[h3]Internal Testing[/h3]

Every day after lunch, we get 5 people from our team to sit down and play 1v4 online on the latest internal build for [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] that has 1v4 enabled. As the internal build is changing so often, playing it daily is important to make sure we can feedback on what has been fixed and what issues are still there. With our highly skilled QA team leading these sessions, they know exactly what to look for as well.

Thanks to all this testing, we’ve also been able to firmly confirm that our QA tester Stephen is the best [i]Fury of Dracula[/i] player in the whole office. If we had to run some kind of Fury of Dracula tournament, he’d be the one we put forward!

We've also been able to recreate known issues to help narrow down what is causing bugs for our development team, which is a big help with development!

[h3]Current Development[/h3]

Right now, Sam, our official [i]Master of Everything Online[/i], is working on getting 1v4 ready for you all. He’s already implemented a huge load of features, including problematic cards like ‘Speedy Telegraph’.

Whenever our internal testing encounters a bug, we make sure to throw all 5 player logs and save files at Sam so that he can identify what happened to each player, and where the error came from. For example, we encountered an error where AI hunters would move to different locations to different players - the game would then crash once it realised the mistake had been made and it got conflicting reports from different players. With the logs from every single player involved, we can narrow down the exact moment when the bug occurred, and get it fixed.

We’ve already made it so that while in the online lobby, you can see how many people are currently in a single room. Handy for when you want to see if 4 people are waiting for one more player!

As Sam has been doing so much great work, we’re happy to report that we now have most of the features we need to make sure online works with 5 players - which means we can start looking at bugs and gathering information on what currently doesn’t work!

[h3]Current Bugs[/h3]

Speaking of bugs, right now trading between players causes the game to crash for everyone involved - there are a fair few steps involved in the trading process between the players doing the trade, and then making sure that the trade is properly reflected on every else’s games. We’re grabbing lots of player logs to see what is causing issues, which means we’re doing a great job of ironing out these bugs so far.

And while we have made [i]Speedy Telegraph[/i] work in 1v4, using it to move to a location that is on the trail also causes a whole heap of issues that we need to resolve. Once we can identify what the game is doing differently when it’s a trail space, we can get to work on making sure it works correctly.

[h3]Closed Beta Rollout[/h3]

As of Thursday, 3rd December, we’ve officially handed over a beta version of [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] to our closed beta testers that features 1v4 multiplayer. This will be a massive help in finding bugs and issues, and just generally giving feedback on how the feature performs.

Our beta testers were massively helpful during the run-up to [i]Fury of Dracula[/i] releasing in November, and a lot of them have stuck around to continue helping us out - which we very much appreciate.

[h3]Public Beta Rollout[/h3]

While we do have a good number of beta testers already, we’re well aware that there are a bunch of people who are itching to get their hands on 1v4 and help us iron out any bugs. We’re going to look into how feasible it would be for us to do a public beta, and if one would be needed.

We’ll keep you updated on what we decide to do, as it mainly depends on how development progresses! 

[h3]5 Copies Bundle?[/h3]

If [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] is going to be 5 player, it makes sense to put out a 5 player bundle right? Well, it would… but there are some problems with that.

The main one is that according to the lovely folk at Valve, most of these ‘multiple game’ bundles just get purchased by people looking to turn a profit by selling those extra copies on grey market reselling websites. So for the time being, we’re not going to be offering a discounted bundle that includes 4 giftable copies of the game.

So that is where we’re currently at! If you want to stay tuned for more updates, reach out to us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://twitter.com/Nomadgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://www.facebook.com/NomadGamesLTD/]Facebook[/url] or our official [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Discord[/url]! I’m also lurking in the Steam group chat for Fury of Dracula, if you want to reach out to me there!

notes.title: Answering Community Questions!
notes.content:
Hello hunters!

Recently we put out the call for questions from the community for our team to answer. We got a load of different questions, so we hope you’re ready for a load of different answers! And if you’ve got a question that wasn’t answered here, you can reach out to us on [url=https://twitter.com/Nomadgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/NomadGamesLTD/]Facebook[/url] or our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Discord[/url]!

So without further ado, let's get to those questions:

[h3]Twitch:soerenkepler from Steam writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: There is alot of disappointment first on foremost on not being able to play 4v1. When will it be available?[/b]

A: We definitely understand that there are people out there who are waiting for us to add 4v1 online multiplayer to the game, which is why it’s the first feature we’ve been working on post-release. We’ve already got to the point where we can test it internally and we’re now gearing up to roll it out to our beta testers. A feature like this involves a lot of different moving parts that need to be checked are working correctly, which is why having our beta testers get their hands on it will help massively.

So at this point, it really depends on how many issues we/our beta crew come across when testing 1v4 online. After we’ve had some more time with it, we’ll be able to give you all a firm date on when it should be available - but we don’t want to promise anything before we know for sure.

In the meantime, we appreciate all of the patience people have shown while we continue working on this much requested feature!

[h3]Spockhelp from Steam writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: Which table top edition is this based off of?[/b]

A: It’s based off the 4th Edition of the table top game! We’ve made some very minor changes where rules weren’t 100% clear in the physical version, but other than that, the game is a 1-to-1 adaptation of the 4th Edition.

[h3]Gorgo Primus and Opsrey26 from Steam write:[/h3]

[b]Q: is it possible to get an option to skip or speed up animations in the future? //  I would also like to see an option to fast forward the visual attacks and stuff.[/b]

A: So depending on which animations players find too lengthy, we may already have unreleased ways of decreasing the wait time. For example, there is a slider in the developer build which controls the speed of the character wheel (the animation you have to wait for when switching characters, finishing your turn etc.)

There is no way for players to use this currently of course, but we wouldn't object to giving the players the option to adjust this themselves. We could also potentially allow other animation speeds to be controllable through the settings menu - we just need to identify the long-winded ones that players find frustrating.

[h3]Gorgo Primus from Steam also writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: Why did you decide to not have text on what a card did when you drew it or in your hand, but only when you went to play them?[/b]

A: So when we looked at how to show players new cards that they had received, we had two options:
[olist]
[*] Show you the card and what it does, and ask players to confirm once they’d read the card
[*] Show you the name of the card, and after a few seconds automatically progress the game
[/olist]
We decided to go with the second option, as it means there is less input required from the player and a game can progress more smoothly. Also, you can look at your hand during your turn and see what the cards do,  so there is still the ability to read what cards do before you play them.

We do acknowledge that there are going to be certain players that would rather it function like the 1st option, so we’re going to look into giving players a choice in the settings menu to toggle between the two options.

[h3]Shawn.hollon from Steam writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: Will there be support to play this on Mac in the near future?[/b]

A: At the moment we don’t have any plans to bring Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition to Mac, as the amount of time it takes to develop a Mac version of the game wouldn’t justify the number of people who then would buy the game.

However, we’re currently looking at other options such as Nvidia's GeForce Now which would allow Mac players to play Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition with minimal development time from us.

[h3]Opsrey26 from Steam writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: Please decrease this size of the player piece. They are too big. Also, add some artwork fro the towns and villages.[/b]

A: At the moment, the player pieces on the board will automatically scale down whenever there are multiple characters in a single location. We’ve designed them to visible even when you’re zoomed out to see the entire board, to help you see at a glance where everyone is.

As we get closer to the release of the mobile version, we can take another look at the sizes of player pieces, and if we need to give players the option to adjust the ‘default’ size.
 
[h3]Billyzero from Steam writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: How do you use Speedy Telegram in game? I know the effect but I don't know how the computer game's mechanic works (ie, how do I get Mina to go first instead of Goldaming when the card is in play?).[/b]

A: If you click on the different character avatars over on the left side of the screen, you’ll be able to switch between the different characters and perform their actions!

[h3]Red Commander from Steam writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: Is it possible to add the list of players actions during the game?[/b]

A: Yes! We’re actually working on this right now, with ‘The Journal’ feature. It will be a running log of everything that has happened in the game, and you’ll be able to refer to it as you play. You can read more about it in our ‘What’s Next for Fury of Dracula’ blog here.

[h3]Red Commander from Steam also writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: [Can there be] an opportunity to choose the leading hunter in a combat? He is being chosen automatically now, due to the sequence of hunter`s turns.[/b]

A: If there are multiple hunters in Dracula’s current location, each hunter chooses a card. Then, before cards are revealed, Dracula chooses one hunter to be the engaged hunter - so Dracula is the one responsible for choosing who the ‘leading hunter’ is in combat.

[h3]Red Commander and El-DoX from Steam write:[/h3]

[b]Q: One more thing. Can we have the better textures of the gaming board? It makes my eyes very tired even in full hd. // Are there some plans to improve the look of the game board, a different layout for instance with a DLC?[/b]

A: So far we’ve mostly seen people wanting it to look like the 2nd/3rd/4th edition physical boards. That could potentially be easy for us to do, but we’d need to talk to the different companies who made those versions of the game. Definitely a conversation we can start though!

[h3]Rogersdrums from Steam writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: is there a possibility that you could manage to make a function in FOD that would allow players to make the game longer in its starting point duration? perhaps increase the evil influence number to 20 or so for example.[/b]

A: Whenever we look at adding house rules in the future, adding rules that change the duration of a game will definitely be on our list. We know that some people will appreciate a shorter game of Fury of Dracula, so adding some kind of ‘sliding scale’ that will adjust aspects that affect game length makes a lot of sense.

[h3]TenaciousD_ad from Steam writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: Castle Dracula did not heal Dracula. Guys, did this really get beta tested?[/b]

A: This was actually a bug we noticed shortly after release! It turns out that Dracula healing after moving to Castle Dracula was being triggered by most of his movement options, but not all of them! For example, when Dracula used Wolf Form to move to Castle Dracula, he wouldn’t heal properly. We’ve now fixed this issue, and will be rolling out a patch for it soon!

Also, we most definitely did beta test the game! We had a team of nearly 100 beta testers who spent nearly 3 months playing the game and reporting on bugs. They're still giving us reports even now the game is out, so they're all mighty dedicated. ːheartː

[h3]Monica Rohtmaa-Jackson on Twitter writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: Why did you decide to digitise Fury of Dracula in particular?[/b]

A: Part of the reason is down to the really good relationship between us and the lovely folk over at Games Workshop! Also, we’ve spent a lot of time working on more ‘traditional’ fantasy games with wizards and knights, so getting our hands on something with such a strong horror theme was definitely a welcome change!

[h3]Iain Briggs on Twitter writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: Is there possibility we'll see it on the Switch?[/b]

A: Once we’ve released the mobile versions of Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition we’re going to properly investigate how much of an audience and how much demand there is for the game on Nintendo Switch. So right now, the best answer we can give you is a big, exciting… maybe?

[h3]John of Arc on Twitter writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: When is the iOS version coming?[/b]

A: We’re still not 100% sure on how long some features of the mobile version of Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition will take, as we have a long list of small features and updates that we need to work on before we can roll it out.

When you have 4 massive things to work on, it’s a bit easier to gauge how long a project will take. Unfortunately, porting Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition to mobile is more like 4 massive things and 100 smaller things, and trying to work out how long those 100 smaller things is much more difficult.

We know that iOS and Android versions are something we get a lot of questions about, so we’ll be sure to shout loud and proud about a release date once we have one!

[h3]David Umstattd on Facebook writes:[/h3]

[b]Q: We’re y’all fans of the board game before designing it? If so how many and for how long? What was the research process like for those unfamiliar with the game?[/b]

A: We had a handful of fans here in the office, and almost everyone had heard of the game to some capacity at least. When a game has been around for as long as Fury of Dracula, it’s hard not to be recognisable. For anyone who was unfamiliar with the game, we bought some copies for the office and we spent a good number of lunches playing through the game and getting to grips with the mechanics.

Games Workshop were also kind enough to send everything they had about Fury of Dracula which helped a lot with research about the game.

[h3]That's it for questions, but don't be shy about reaching out to us on social media or here on Steam![/h3]

notes.title: What's Next for Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition?
notes.content:
Hello Hunters!

So, last week we finally released [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] upon you all. Thanks to your support, it’s been our most successful launch in the history of Nomad Games - it’s really blown us away how much feedback, love and suggestions we’ve received from you all. [i](As the person responsible for looking at all our social media, I can tell you that release day and the following days were pretty overwhelming!)[/i]

Now that we’ve had some time to get over the initial release, I’ve sat down with the rest of the team to properly outline what we’ve got planned for the future of [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i]. Here at Nomad, we’ve been doing our best to be transparent during development of the game, and we’ll keep that up going forward too! This is one hell of an update, so grab yourself a drink and some snacks and get set for the long haul! We have a lot to cover, so we’ve divided it into sections if you want to skip to specific features.

But as a starting point for transparency, we want to address something that a number of people have already brought up:

[h3]Why have you released the game now, instead of holding off until these features were finished?[/h3]

To answer that question, we need to give you a peek behind the indie game development scene. We have a staff of around 20 people, who we pay to make our games, and we rent out an office here in the UK. When we’re looking at our finances, we look at how much we’re hoping to earn throughout the year and how much we’re going to be spending. If we work out that a certain month is going to be rocky for us, we can rest easy knowing that we have an upcoming game release that will help bolster our finances and keep us afloat - something that we’re more aware of than ever during the Covid-19 pandemic.

As soon as we start pushing back a big game release like [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i], we’re left with a big gap in our financial plans. Remember, we’re only a small studio - it’s not like we can release other content that a different team has been working on. So instead, we made the decision to release the base version of [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] now, with the promise of future updates to add features we know players will want.

And we know that this is a decision that relies on you, the players, trusting us to come through on that promise! We’re well aware that the video game industry is under more scrutiny than ever before, with headlines about loot-boxes, crunch and mistreated workers seemingly hitting front pages with no end. So we know it’s a big ask for you to put your trust in us, but we hope that by fulfilling our promises, we’ll be able to show you we’re deserving of that trust! Also, updating a game as time goes isn’t something new to us at Nomad - 7 years on, we’re still adding new features to [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i] after community requests!

Turns out giving a transparent answer takes a while! So without further ado, let’s go through everything we’re currently working on and are planning to work on:

[h3]Steam Achievements[/h3]

Probably the most finished thing on this list for [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i], our Steam achievements were just slightly unfinished when we hit release day.

We’ve already got most of the coding done in the back-end, and we’ve now finished making all those lovely little icons that you’ll see when you unlock them in game. Our next step will be to test them to make sure they unlock as they should and are bug-free, and then you’ll be able to get bragging rights over your friends!

[h3]1v4 multiplayer[/h3]

Definitely the most requested feature so far (across Steam reviews, our Discord and social media) is 1v4 multiplayer. We’ve heard you loud and clear, and know that this is the feature most requested across the board.

So, the first thing to do is let you all know exactly where we’re currently at with 1v4. The good news is that we already have 1v4 online in a state where we can test it internally with our QA team. Right now it [i]technically[/i] works, and you’d be able to play through an entire game of [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] online if you know what doesn’t work. The moment you start trying to do something that doesn’t work though… that’s when things start to get ugly.

So right now, we have a list of things that need to be updated to properly work in 1v4 multiplayer. This makes our jobs easier, as we can just work through that list and make it smaller and smaller.

A good example of this is the card [i]‘Speedy Telegraph’[/i]. Suddenly throwing out the set order of activations when you need to keep track of 4 different hunters on completely different systems causes a whole heap of edge-cases and issues to arise. This is something we need to make sure works before we roll out 1v4 to you all. 

Also, our list of things that need to be updated doesn’t account for bugs and issues that we can’t possibly foresee - which makes it hard for us to judge exactly how long this update will take to come out. As we continue crushing bugs and getting closer to finishing the update though, we’ll be able to give you a definitive release date.

Speaking of, one of the key weapons in our arsenal of bug-crushing are the lovely team of beta testers we’ve had helping us with [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] before release. We still have some things we need to update before we can give the 1v4 multiplayer mode over to our beta testers, but we’re hoping they can start sinking their fangs into it starting in early December.

Now that Steam has rolled out new features to help people beta test their games (you can read more about it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/steamworks/announcements/detail/2954884882167446258]here[/url] if you’re interested!) we’ll also be in a better position to add more beta testers to the game so we can thoroughly thrash out bugs in 1v4 multiplayer. If we decide we need more beta testers, we’ll be sure to put out a call to the community!

[h3]Rejoining Games[/h3]

Something we’ve got planned to add to [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] after we roll out the 1v4 update, is improving the ability for people to rejoin online games after disconnecting. The reason we’re bringing this up now is that it’s a good example of how adding 1v4 multiplayer is a complicated process!

Right now you can rejoin a disconnected game of [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] up to one minute after you disconnect, unless you quit or close the game. But we need to make sure that we code and design 1v4 multiplayer so that it plays nicely with rejoining games. We don’t want to code ourselves into a corner, so we need to do the groundwork now for rejoining online games, which adds time to the development of 1v4 multiplayer.

So, ahead of the 1v4 update we’re going to be looking at things like:
[list]
[*] How big of a window we’ll allow for people to rejoin after disconnecting
[*] Looking at ‘player states’ and how we define whether a player is ‘idle’ or ‘away’ online
[*] Giving people the option to wait for disconnected players or swap them to AI if they fail to reconnect
[/list]
These are all things we need to take into consideration and work on before we can roll out 1v4. We’re confident that we’ll be able to get all these things done, it’ll just take time.

[h3]Text chat[/h3]

Something else that we’ve heard your requests for is text chat! This is slightly lower on our priority list, but is also easier to implement. We’ve already got this feature in a number of our other games, so we understand the process of implementing it very well.

We’re going to add chat to the game room and in game, so you’ll be able to chat before the game starts and during the game as well.

Something we’ve already discussed is if we’d need to keep any chat hidden from Dracula, but we’ve agreed that most of the chat done during a game of [i]Fury of Dracula[/i] is open anyway so we don’t need a filter. This fits with how you’d play the physical board game too!

[h3]iOS and Android versions[/h3]

Something else that has been highly requested over the past months has been a release date for the iOS and Android versions of the game. The good news is that we’ve been making the mobile version of [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] in parallel with the PC version, so a huge amount of the work has already been done.

So what still needs to be done? Well, at the moment, we need to:
[list]
[*] Optimise the user interface
[*] Update a bunch of assets so they work better on mobile
[*] Fully implement touch screen support
[*] Add support for dragging certain items across the screen
[*] Add push notification support
[*] Implement a ton of smaller updates that pile up
[/list]
Now that the Steam version has been released, we can start looking at making our way through this list. We know roughly how long things like adding push notifications will take, as we’ve done it in other games before. However, there are still a number of unknowns as we go into the Christmas period and people start taking holidays. So at the moment, we’re still not in a position to share a firm release date, but as we whittle down the list of things that need doing, we’ll be able to share a firm release date with you all!

[h3]More tutorials/guides[/h3]

We’ve made a good number of digital board games over the years, and one thing we know players really care about is that the tutorial is spot on.

Unfortunately for us, the tutorial is always the very last thing you put in a digital board game, because you first need to make sure everything else is finished! For example, we can’t put in a combat tutorial until we make sure that combat is fully fleshed out and working in-game.

So due to that, we only had a limited amount of time to work on the tutorials - so we still have some tutorials that are waiting to be implemented into the game! We’re also going to be adding more interactive guides, so the first time you interact with things you’ll get a handy-dandy reminder about what exactly it does.

At the moment, we’re planning on adding tutorials for:
[list]
[*] Trading as Hunters
[*] Advanced Rules - Lairs
[*] Advanced Rules - Rumour Tokens 
[*] Victory Conditions
[*] In-Play Cards
[*] Resting and Hunter Health
[/list]
If there is anything else you’d like to see get a dedicated tutorial, feel free to let us know!

[h3]House rules [/h3]

Something we heard a lot of people request before the game launched was in-game house rules! [i]Fury of Dracula[/i] is a game that has been around for 30+ years at this point, so it’s had plenty of time to pick up some community favourite house rules over the years. When making the digital version, we also came up with some of our own ideas for good rules that would enhance the game.

So far, some of the house rules we’re looking forward to implementing the following:
[list]
[*] ‘Pirate Dracula’ discouragement/prevention measures
[*] Allowing hunters to view facedown discarded cards in certain situations
[*] Allowing delayed hunters to use their whole turn to become undelayed when Renewed Vigor is in play
[*] Dracula being able to choose to not mature cards when a hideout slides off the trail
[*] Bat tokens being removed from Hunters when they’re defeated
[*] Roadblocks not affecting Dracula moving hunters
[/list]
We know you all will have suggestions for house rules, so in December we’ll be rolling out an official ‘What House Rules do you want to be added’ questionnaire so your feedback isn’t missed!

This is a feature where we’ll be happy to continue updating [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] with more house rules as time goes on too, so don’t worry if your favourite rule isn’t put in straight away.

[h3]Variations in AI difficulty[/h3]

Something that we’ve had a lot of player feedback on is the AI difficulty in the game. Especially in our Steam reviews, players have been pointing out that the AI in [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] doesn’t pose enough of a challenge for experienced players.

Our plan currently is to release regular updates to the AI that will improve it over time, as we have more information to work with and more time to improve it. This means that if you play [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] every single day, these changes might be harder to spot - but as time goes on, the AI will become more robust and intelligent.

We’re also going to be adding 3 different difficulty levels for the AI! We’re ready to test this internally, and while we’re working on the game we can have an AI vs AI match up on a second monitor to keep an eye on what they’re doing. This is quite therapeutic actually, as we can just watch the AI do their best to outsmart each other.

[h3]The Journal[/h3]

What is a hunter without their journal? We’re currently working on a ‘log’ feature for [i]Fury[/i] that will keep track of every action that has happened in the game. We’re hoping that it’ll come in handy if you miss something or need a reminder of what happened a few turns back.

However, we don’t just want something that gives you a list of actions - not in a game like [i]Fury of Dracula[/i]! Our idea for the Journal is that it’ll be a narrative tool as well, inspired by the fact the original Dracula novel itself was composed of news reports and letters. 

Instead of just saying [i]“Mina Harker moved to London and entered combat with a Reckless Vampire. The Reckless Vampire was defeated and Mina Harker suffered 3 damage due to combat.”[/i] we want something that captures the theme of the original novel! So in the journal, this would appear as [i]“Mina Harker arrived in London, following rumours of Dracula from local police. The rumours proved to be true, as we can report she was attacked by a Reckless Vampire while investigating an abandoned apartment in Whitechapel. Luckily she escaped with her life, only suffering minor injuries (3 damage).[/i]

We’re going to spend a good amount of time making sure the Journal flows correctly, so that each game of [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] ends up creating a unique story for you to read through once you’ve finished the game.

Also, unlike games where all information is publicly available, the log in [i]Fury of Dracula[/i] is going to be different for every single player, and we don’t want hunters deducing anything from an update that should only be seen by Dracula for example. So this does add a bit more extra development time!

[h3]Friends Support for User Accounts[/h3]

As part of bringing the game to mobile, we want to make it super easy to play with your friends in whatever way works best for you. We know it’s not easy to expect 5 people to all have PCs and to all be online at the same time, which is why we’re working on adding cross-platform friend support to the game.

Once you’ve signed into your Nomad Account, you’ll be able to see and add other friends, regardless of the platform they’re on. Not only will this mean you’ll be able to compare your stats with your friends, you’ll be able to invite them to games!

[h3]Translations[/h3]

Once we have the time to do so, we’re planning to properly sit down and evaluate what languages we want to translate [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] into. The good news is that we have a whole heap of information to inform that decision, including:
[list]
[*] How well the physical game has sold in different languages
[*] How well the physical game has sold in different countries
[*] How many members of the community have requested different languages
[*] Languages the physical board game has already been translated into
[*] How well languages have been adopted in our other games
[/list]
So we’re very confident that we’ll be able to make smart decisions about where to focus our efforts for translation so that it’ll have the most positive impact!

[h3]Other platforms[/h3]

At the moment, we’re focusing on bringing the game to mobile because we know for sure that there is a large audience there. We’ve also had a lot of historical success on mobile, which means we can be confident that [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] will perform well there.

When it comes to other platforms like MacOS and Nintendo Switch, we’re a lot less confident in how [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] will perform. Because of this, we need to take the time to sit down and properly evaluate the risks and benefits of bringing [i]Fury[/i] to each platform to make sure that it’s a decision that makes sense, business-wise.

As soon as we have time to do that (on top of everything else we’re doing), we’ll be in a much better position to confirm or deny what platforms we want to bring [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] to. Of course, letting us know you’re keen for a certain platform puts it on our radar too! So if you’re holding out for that [b]Sega Game Gear[/b] version, let us know!

[h3]What else are you working on?[/h3]

Right now, our immediate concern is squashing bugs that you’ve all been kind enough to point out over the past week. We’ve still got a few to get though, but thanks to everyone who submitted detailed reports of what issues they’ve encountered, we’ve been able to make great progress.

We’ll hopefully be pushing out bug-fixing patches regularly between now and Christmas, so stay tuned to our Steam announcements for patch notes. We'll also be keeping a close eye on the community - so if there is anything that hasn't been answered here, please let us know! We'll do our best to answer any questions you have. You can reach out to us here on Steam or via [url=https://www.facebook.com/NomadGamesLTD/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Nomadgames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/nomad_games/?hl=en]Instagram[/url]. Or if you’d like, you can bolster the ranks of hunters on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Discord[/url] and chat more directly to the devs!

We've already asked for questions from the community [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/958530/discussions/0/2979655949475453393/]here on Steam[/url], and I'll be making a separate post that answers community questions.

And finally, I want to thank everyone who has purchased the game and supported us on behalf of the entire Nomad Games team. This has been the most successful launch in the history of the company, and that wouldn’t be the case without you telling your friends, leaving Steam reviews and generally supporting us.

So from the whole team, thank you! ːheartː

notes.title: Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition is out now!
notes.content:
Hello Hunters!

The big day is finally here! We got through a slight delay, worked hard alongside our wonderful beta testers and spent a whole year working hard on [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] through a global pandemic, and now it's finally available to purchase!

To celebrate, we're offering a week long launch discount, where you'll be able to grab the game for 10% off. And as thanks to everyone who has already supported our small studio, we're also offering everyone who owns [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i] an [b]extra[/b] 10% off the game! We wouldn't be where we are today without the support you've all given us over the years, so this is our way of saying thanks. ːheartː

We're also offering a discounted bundle for [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] that includes both the game and the official soundtrack. Our in-house composer has been working to make the perfect soundtrack for [i]Fury of Dracula[/i], and you can read more about it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/958530/view/2922233784876373398]here[/url] if you're interested!

[h3]What happens now the game is released?[/h3]

First of all, we're going to all celebrate here at Nomad! We still can't all go into the office, so releasing a game feels a lot weirder than it normally would. We're sure we'll find a way to celebrate the release, but it definitely won't be our usual trip to the local pub! We'll also be keeping an eye on outlets for their reviews and coverage, and the community as well.

We're also not finished with [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] development! We'll be keeping a close eye on feedback and bug reports from our lovely community for things that need fixing, and we've already got a list of things we're going to be rolling out in future updates.

These include, but are not limited to: 
[list]
[*] More tutorials/guides
[*] House rules
[*] Variations in AI difficulty
[*] 1v4 multiplayer
[*] iOS and Android support
[/list]
We'll be putting together a fully fledged [b]What's Next for Fury of Dracula?[/b] blog soon, to share a much more detailed update with you all. We're very open to suggestions on what you'd like to see, so please reach out to us if you have ideas!

You can chat to us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/NomadGamesLTD/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Nomadgames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/nomad_games/?hl=en]Instagram[/url]. Or if you’d like, you can bolster the ranks of hunters on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Discord[/url]

And finally, we want to thank everyone who has supported us in the run-up to launching [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i]. It looks set to be the biggest launch in our history as a games studio, and that wouldn't be the case without your support. ːheartː

notes.title: Fury of Dracula - Dev Blog Vol. 8
notes.content:
[i][b]We’re close now, I can feel it. My blood aches as we get closer and closer to our encounter with Dracula. Every night I dream of that same crimson sea, my eyes transfixed on the inhuman beast who stalks its waves with gnashing teeth. It knows we’re closing in, and the beast hungers.[/b][/i]
[i][list]
[*] Excerpt from Mina Harker's diary, dated March 1894
[/list][/i]

Hello hunters!

We’ve got an especially exciting [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] developer blog for you all this week, as a lot of placeholder assets have been converted into their final versions. For months now, we’ve been sharing screenshots where specific features were improved, but all the cool stuff in the background was still being worked on. With all these final assets in the game, you can get a much better idea of how the game will look when you get your hands on it.

Also, thanks to the positive feedback we’ve been getting on these blogs, we’ve been looking at what we can do to replace them when [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] has actually been released. If you have any ideas for what you’d like to hear from us, feel free to reach out and let us know!

But enough about that, it’s time to share what we’ve been working on this week!

[h3]Interactive guides[/h3]

Along with our dedicated tutorials, we’ve now put interactive tutorials into the game! These helpful tips will pop up during the game to remind you how certain mechanics work. These can be toggled on and off, and are designed to give you a helping hand when you come across a new feature you haven’t encountered before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38289266/1c8777bf0b01bdfd59ea901416f6cefe9a2738c9.jpg[/img]

[h3]Updating the credits[/h3]

This took a while to get around to, but we’ve finally made the credits look nice! We’ve also got specific music for the credits for when you’re looking through all of our fantastic names, and what we did to help bring this game to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38289266/e1a7e87c6407a43b6daa717194dafc59adb2d44b.jpg[/img]

This is where our beta testers will also be featured, as thanks for helping us iron out bugs and giving feedback on the game!

[h3]Updating the artwork[/h3]

Remember how the card area down at the bottom of the screen used to look? Our art team have now got around to updating the card holder with isometric decks and the final flourishes. Looks much better, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38289266/75b546e769a6c423a632083540825e3eb325092a.jpg[/img]

That’s not the only part of the user interface we’ve made look fancier though! Check out the new look we’ve given to the trail too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38289266/90a313e9606bacf7234f70d7935ac561e55493ce.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dracula Marker[/h3]

A new feature we’ve added in this update is the ‘Dracula Marker’. This is a special pin that players can place to signal to other hunters where they think Dracula is at the moment. Have you got a sneaking suspicion that Dracula is lurking in London? Let the other players know by placing your Dracula marker there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38289266/c8406431acb90d733021c61b1046c63687e2dba9.jpg[/img]

We designed this feature in order to help players easily signal key information to each other quickly, so we hope you find it useful when the game launches!

[h3]Added a bunch of new menus[/h3]

While we were swapping out placeholders, we also updated a load of different menus as well. First up was the menu for when you need to choose a specific space on Dracula’s trail. Now you’re presented with a visual of the different spaces, to help you make a better choice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38289266/fc00100b5c7119de7f53995078f1d10fe4f67e22.jpg[/img]

Do you need to select cards, or make choices about them? We’ve got fancy looking new menus for that too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38289266/43a7c0e6e779317e498e15c4a1cb3d64c1ba232a.jpg[/img]
